localize.text: Address of the chat-side server's WebSocket endpoint. Example: wss://example.com/mod/socket
Authentication token sent during connection. Treat this as a secret.
When off, the mod stays disconnected and effects do not run.
When on, effects that can swing a run (such as releasing a creature) are allowed. When off, those effects are rejected.
Maximum number of effects waiting to run at once. Extra redemptions arriving past this limit are rejected immediately.
Minimum seconds between any two effects. Set to 0 to disable global throttling.
Amount of energy added or removed when those effects fire.
Amount of LOB Points granted by the add money effect.
Server URL must start with ws:// or wss://
